user.title: E-REDES delivery point
user.description:
Enter the CPE of the delivery point to import from {setup_url}.

No token is stored. To import consumption, open this entry's options ("Sync now") or call the `eredes.sync` action with a freshly pasted token.

data_description.cpe: Your delivery point code, e.g. PT0002000012345678XX.

error.invalid_cpe: That does not look like a CPE (PT followed by 18 letters or digits).

init.title: Sync now
init.description:
Paste a fresh access token to import the consumption that is missing from the Energy dashboard. The token is used for this sync only and is never stored.

To get it: log into {setup_url}, open the browser dev tools (F12), go to Application > Cookies and copy the value of the 'aat' cookie. The token expires a short while after login, so sync right away.

data_description.token: The 'aat' cookie value, 'aat=…', or the full Cookie header.
data_description.dry_run: Fetch and compute everything, but write nothing.
data_description.history_days: How far back the first import goes. Ignored once statistics exist.

error.token_expired: E-REDES refused the token (401). It has expired: log in again and paste a fresh one.
error.captcha_challenge: E-REDES answered with a reCAPTCHA challenge (403). This is not a token problem; nothing was written. Try again later.
error.access_denied: E-REDES denied access (403). Check that the CPE belongs to the account that issued the token.
error.http_error: E-REDES answered with HTTP status {status}. Nothing was written.
error.http_error_first_block: E-REDES answered with HTTP status {status} for the oldest part of the window. Nothing was written. If your contract is recent, try fewer history days.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach E-REDES. Nothing was written.
error.unexpected_response: E-REDES returned a response that could not be understood. Nothing was written.
error.unsuccessful_after_data: E-REDES reported a failure for request block {block}, after earlier blocks had returned data. Nothing was written.
error.empty_block_between_data: Request block {block} came back empty between blocks with data. Nothing was written, to avoid importing a hole.
error.no_successful_response: E-REDES did not return a successful response for any part of the window. Check the CPE and the history days.
error.sync_in_progress: A sync for this CPE is already running.
error.token_missing: No access token found in the pasted value.

sync.name: Sync consumption
sync.description: Imports the consumption missing from the E-REDES long-term statistic, using a freshly pasted access token. Warning: Home Assistant records action data, including this token, in its database; the entry's "Sync now" option does not.

token.description: The 'aat' cookie value, 'aat=…', or the full Cookie header. Used for this call only.
